title: Injury Risk Reduction Routine 1
summary: Injury Risk Reduction session focusing on tissue capacity, stability, muscle balance.
riskReason: Strengthening weaker areas and improving stability may reduce risk but does not cure injuries. Perform exercises with control and proper form.
easierVariant: Perform fewer repetitions or reduce sets.
coachingNotes: Strengthening weaker areas and improving stability may reduce risk but does not cure injuries.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes include poor form, rushing through exercises, or skipping warm-up.
safetyNotes: Focus on quality over quantity. Stop if you experience pain or dizziness.
